structured.reason: an alert is firing on a production service

entries.text: The checkout container was OOMKilled three times inside the incident window [e1], and each kill was followed by a back-off restart. Its memory limit is 512Mi.

structured.root_cause: the checkout container exceeded its 512Mi memory limit
structured.summary: checkout was OOMKilled three times inside the window [e1]; requests failed during each restart. The memory limit is 512Mi and the process exceeded it.
causal_chain: memory use grew past the 512Mi limit
remediation_steps: raise the checkout memory limit to 1Gi
profile the allocation growth under load
